authentication: administrator Bearer token, website backend only
scope: user ownership AND explicit Node allocation delegation; sudo bypasses delegation

request.operation_id: canonical lowercase UUID; persist before dispatch
request.external_reference: nullable string, otherwise 1-128 characters; not payment evidence

http_200: current policy application and Node core readiness confirmed
http_202: accepted but pending or unconfirmed; not effective
get_side_effects: none; does not restart or grant
write_side_effects: permission/audit and target Node reconciliation only; may restart target core
idempotency: same operation and payload never reapplies a superseded grant; changed payload returns 409
deployment: one active panel worker/controller per independently owned Node core
